views.name: superhero_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  superhero.id AS id,
  superhero.superhero_name AS superhero_name,
  superhero.full_name AS full_name,
  superhero.gender_id AS gender_id,
  superhero.eye_colour_id AS eye_colour_id,
  superhero.hair_colour_id AS hair_colour_id,
  superhero.skin_colour_id AS skin_colour_id,
  superhero.race_id AS race_id,
  superhero.publisher_id AS publisher_id,
  superhero.alignment_id AS alignment_id,
  superhero.height_cm AS height_cm,
  superhero.weight_kg AS weight_kg
FROM superhero
views.description: One row per superhero with canonical identity and foreign-key ids to related dimensions (gender, colours, race, publisher, alignment) and basic physical measures.
validated_on: List the superheroes from Marvel Comics who have the super power of 'Super Strength'.
How many gold-eyed superheroes did Marvel Comics publish?
What is Copycat's race?
What are the names of the superheroes with the power of death touch?
How many female superheroes have a strength value of 100?
What is the total number of superheroes without full name?
What is the average weight of all female superheroes?
Among the superheroes with height from 170 to 190, list the names of the superheroes with no eye color.
In superheroes with height between 150 to 180, what is the percentage of heroes published by Marvel Comics?
Among the male superheroes, list the super hero names of superheroes with weight greater than the 79% average weight of all superheroes.
counter_examples: Provide the hair colour of the human superhero who is 185 cm tall.

views.name: hero_power_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  hero_id,

FROM hero_power

validated_on: What are the superpowers of heroes with ID 1?
How many heroes have stealth power?

SELECT

validated_on: Among the superheroes with the super power of "Super Strength", how many of them have a height of over 200cm?
List the superheroes from Marvel Comics who have the super power of 'Super Strength'.

How many heroes have stealth power?

views.name: hero_to_power
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  hero_id AS hero_id,
  power_id AS power_id
FROM hero_power
views.description: Denormalized relation linking each hero to each of their powers (one row per hero-power link). Useful to form cohorts of heroes that have particular powers.
validated_on: List the superheroes from Marvel Comics who have the super power of 'Super Strength'.
What are the names of the superheroes with the power of death touch?

views.name: colour_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  colour
FROM colour
views.description: Mapping of colour id to colour name for colour attributes (eye/hair/skin).
validated_on: Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes and blond hair.
counter_examples: List the eyes, hair and skin colour of all female superheroes published by Dark Horse Comics.

views.name: hero_power_link_5
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  hp.hero_id AS hero_id,
  hp.power_id AS power_id,
  sp.power_name AS power_name
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
views.description: One row per hero-power link, providing hero id with the joined power name for filtering heroes by power.
validated_on: What are the superpowers of heroes with ID 1?

views.name: superhero_with_colour_names
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sc.id,
  sc.superhero_name,
  sc.full_name,
  ce.colour AS eye_colour,
  ch.colour AS hair_colour,
  cs.colour AS skin_colour,
  sc.gender_id,
  sc.race_id,
  sc.publisher_id,
  sc.alignment_id,
  sc.height_cm,
  sc.weight_kg
FROM superhero_core sc
LEFT JOIN colour_lookup ce ON sc.eye_colour_id = ce.id
LEFT JOIN colour_lookup ch ON sc.hair_colour_id = ch.id
LEFT JOIN colour_lookup cs ON sc.skin_colour_id = cs.id
views.description: Denormalized superhero rows augmented with eye, hair, and skin colour text by joining superhero to the colour lookup three times. Provides human-readable colour columns for easy filtering and selection.
validated_on: Which publisher published the slowest superhero?
Among the superheroes with height from 170 to 190, list the names of the superheroes with no eye color.

views.name: publisher_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM publisher
views.description: Mapping of publisher id to publisher_name. Useful to resolve publisher_name filters and to join publisher metadata onto heroes.
validated_on: How many gold-eyed superheroes did Marvel Comics publish?

views.name: hero_with_publisher

FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
views.description: Denormalized view joining superheroes to publisher names (one row per superhero). Exposes hero id, hero name, height_cm and publisher_name to make publisher-based cohorts and selections easy.

views.name: superhero_with_publisher_and_eye
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.id AS id,
  s.superhero_name AS superhero_name,
  s.publisher_id AS publisher_id,
  p.publisher_name AS publisher_name,

  c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
views.description: Denormalized row per superhero including publisher name and eye colour text for grouping and filtering in analysis queries.

views.name: hero_attribute_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  hero_id,
  attribute_id,

FROM hero_attribute
views.description: Row-level hero attribute measurements: one row per hero + attribute pairing with raw attribute_value. Useful to filter by attribute type (e.g., Speed) and compute minima, maxima, or other aggregations later.

counter_examples: Which superhero has the most durability published by Dark Horse Comics?

views.name: attribute_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM attribute
views.description: Canonical attribute id/name mapping to normalize attribute lookup by name (e.g., map 'Speed' to its attribute.id).

views.name: hero_attribute_values
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  har.hero_id AS hero_id,
  s.superhero_name AS superhero_name,
  s.full_name AS full_name,
  har.attribute_id AS attribute_id,
  a.attribute_name AS attribute_name,
  har.attribute_value AS attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute AS har
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = har.hero_id
LEFT JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = har.attribute_id
views.description: Denormalized row for each hero-attribute pair, including hero identity, attribute metadata, and the attribute value.
validated_on: How many female superheroes have a strength value of 100?
Among the male superheroes, list the super hero names of superheroes with weight greater than the 79% average weight of all superheroes.

views.name: race_lookup

views.name: superhero_with_race
views.body_sql:

views.description: Denormalized view joining superheroes to their race text (one row per superhero, with race as text). Useful for queries that filter or group by race or need the race text directly.

views.name: superhero_with_publisher

counter_examples: List the eyes, hair and skin colour of all female superheroes published by Dark Horse Comics.

views.name: superhero_attributes_and_powers
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ha.hero_id AS hero_id,
  ha.attribute_id AS attribute_id,
  ha.attribute_value AS attribute_value,
  hp.power_id AS power_id
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp
  ON ha.hero_id = hp.hero_id
UNION
SELECT
  hp2.hero_id AS hero_id,
  NULL AS attribute_id,
  NULL AS attribute_value,
  hp2.power_id AS power_id
FROM hero_power AS hp2
LEFT JOIN hero_attribute AS ha2
  ON hp2.hero_id = ha2.hero_id
WHERE ha2.hero_id IS NULL
views.description: Hero-level exploded view that links each superhero to their attributes and powers (one row per hero-attribute and one row per hero-power can be produced via UNION or separate outputs). Useful for filtering/ranking heroes by attributes or presence of powers.
